text: NotificationSounds reuses an Audio object for the same URL, pauses and replaces it for another URL, and pauses on profile shutdown. Creating an Audio object requires a recent mail:3pane window. Its notification-audio-ended observer callback is installed only in automation and runs on natural ended events. The JSDoc's general stops wording is broader than that code; pause and shutdown do not emit the topic here. Audio.play's promise is neither returned nor handled. Keep helper completion, caller policy and audible output separate; no sound or rejection scenario ran.
title: The shared sound helper exposes an automation-ended event, not general playback completion
